svg.aria-label: claude-obsidian hero: you ask Claude to read your sources. Files from the inbox, a pasted note and web research behind a consent lock reach three read-only worker bots, their drafts become one plan, the crew carries it to the Obsidian crystal and it lands as one transaction. Each source becomes a linked star in the knowledge graph, then the vault answers a question, saves the answer as a new note, passes a lint check and levels up.

g.text: Read these and connect them to my notes.
4 sources ready. Search the web too?
Through paper and ideas. 0 files changed.
